# IP-API.com
> Free IP geolocation API for looking up IP addresses with fast, accurate, and reliable location data.

IP-API.com provides IP geolocation lookup services in multiple response formats, along with batch, DNS, and data correction resources. The site focuses on practical API documentation and operational status information.

## Core Documentation
- [Documentation](https://ip-api.com/docs): Main documentation hub for the IP geolocation API and related resources.
- [JSON API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:json): Reference for querying the geolocation API with JSON responses.
- [XML API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:xml): Reference for accessing geolocation results in XML format.
- [CSV API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:csv): Reference for retrieving IP geolocation data as CSV output.
- [Newline API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:newline_separated): Reference for newline-separated geolocation response format.
- [Serialized PHP API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:serialized_php): Reference for consuming geolocation responses as serialized PHP data.

## API Formats
- [JSON API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:json): JSON endpoint documentation with parameters, fields, and example requests.
- [XML API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:xml): XML endpoint documentation for structured geolocation lookups.
- [CSV API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:csv): CSV output documentation for lightweight tabular integrations.
- [Newline API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:newline_separated): Plain text newline-separated output for simple parsing workflows.
- [Serialized PHP API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:serialized_php): PHP-specific serialized response format documentation.

## Advanced API Features
- [Batch API](https://ip-api.com/docs/api:batch): Documentation for submitting multiple IP lookups in a single request.
- [DNS API](https://ip-api.com/docs/dns): Documentation for performing IP geolocation lookups via DNS queries.

## Data Quality and Policies
- [Data Correction](https://ip-api.com/docs/correction): Process for reporting and correcting inaccurate geolocation data.
- [Terms and Policies](https://ip-api.com/docs/legal): Legal terms, usage policies, and service conditions.

## Account and Access
- [Sign Up](https://members.ip-api.com/): Account portal for registering and managing IP-API services.
- [Contact](mailto:contact@ip-api.com): Direct contact address for support and business inquiries.

## Service Operations
- [Service Status](https://status.ip-api.com/): Operational status page for uptime, incidents, and service availability.
